title: Where is the reference?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the chosen reference point.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the chosen reference point affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the chosen reference point in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
